steps.name: Interview Guest
steps.text: The vast lands of the frontier still have considerable potential for development, and we earnestly invite everyone whose talents have not yet been put to their best use to join us out there.

steps.name: Interview Guest
steps.text: But for those who remain steadfastly committed to their hometowns, we've also been preparing a plate redevelopment plan.

steps.name: Host
steps.text: And what is this plan, exactly?

steps.name: Interview Guest
steps.text: For certain plates that have not been meeting industrial benchmarks, we've thought up redevelopment plans to give them a brand new image. The high-tech industries attracted by the state government will make use of these valuable plates to expand their cutting-edge businesses.

steps.name: Host
steps.text: What exciting news! I'm sure all the residents of those plates can't wait to see the bright new future that awaits them.

steps.name: Interview Guest
steps.text: We already have concrete plans for a number of them, including Bayswood, Deadhorse, and Davistown.

steps.name: Host
steps.text: I wonder if anyone in the audience is tuning in from any of those plates? I'm sure it'll be the best news they've heard all year, haha!

steps.name: Bank President
steps.text: Mr. Cliff, you wouldn't believe how excited I am to see the splendor of Fort Barron with my own eyes.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: You're too kind. It's our honor to work with a company like yours.

steps.name: Bank President
steps.text: Hahaha! If at all possible, I would like to continue our partnership across other business ventures, out in the frontier.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: I was just thinking the same thing.

steps.name: Bank President
steps.text: It's always a pleasure to speak with you, and I hope that never changes. After all, towing is a long process, and we might not be parting ways until the snow melts in the spring.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Too soon, if you ask me. A true pity—

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Sir! Sir!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Please, let me in! I have something urgent to report!

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: If you ever need anything, my door is always open—

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Please open the door, sir! It's an emergency! I'm begging you!

steps.name: Bank President
steps.text: ...Sounds like you have urgent matters to attend to?

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Give me just a minute.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: What are you doing here, Jessica? Who gave you permission to come yelling and banging on my door?

steps.name: Secretary
steps.text: My apologies, sir, but the contents of Jessica's report are, in fact, urgent.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Out with it then.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: That man over there...

steps.name: Bank President
steps.text: May I use your restroom?

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Go ahead.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Now, what exactly was so important that you had to come running to me?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: The bank is trying to leverage their deal with the government to make us open fire on a civilian crowd.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: And did you do it?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I can't say what happened after I left, but...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: There's no way we'd obey that order.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Alright, I understand. You can leave now.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: What are we going to do about the residents?

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: That's none of your business.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: But can you at least—

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: If you still don't get it, I'll spell it out for you.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: It's none of your business, and it's none of mine either.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ...Are you serious?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Then what is your business? The massive kickback you're getting from the bank? The extrajudicial privileges that the military grants you? Or is it the feeling you get when you trample people beneath your feet?

spans.text: your business? The massive kickback you're getting from the bank? The extrajudicial privileges that the military grants you? Or is it the feeling you get when you trample people beneath your feet?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: The feeling of being superior to others?
Cliff narrows his eyes, scanning the now-unfamiliar mercenary before him from head to toe.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: I'm in my nineties, Jessica. It takes more than that to get me excited.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Why, then...? What do you get from surrounding yourself with these people?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: How can I not have suspicions? The way I see it... you've thrown away almost all of your humanity, and for what?

spans.text: have suspicions? The way I see it... you've thrown away almost all of your humanity, and for what?

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Humanity... It's a word that means less and less to me as I get older. Blacksteel is a PMC, and I'm the boss. What do I need pretty words for?

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: To put it another way, Jessica, if those are the things you value so much, what are you doing here?

spans.text: To put it another way, Jessica, if those are the things you value so much, what are

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: I remember what your father once told me. That you wanted to resolve conflicts and protect others.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: That's right...

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: In that case, why not become a police officer, a judge, or a peacekeeper? And if all else fails, you could at least become a soldier to protect your family and country, right?

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: But you chose mercenary. A job that uses force for money. A job that's inseparable from death and violence. A job that's devoid of glory or honor.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: And I know you're not short on cash either, so I ask you again, Jessica—what are you even doing here?

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: If you haven't figured it out yet, then I can always give you my answer. Because I have one.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Ambition... For the sake of my own ambitions. To prove that I'm no less than my brothers and sisters. To prove... that I am not a mediocre stain on my family.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: That's why I'm here.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Not bad. I like seeing that clarity and self-awareness.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: So don't stand there and criticize the way I conduct my business. Your father's also an excellent businessman, and as his daughter, you'd do well to learn from him.

spans.text: So don't stand there and criticize the way I conduct
business. Your father's also an excellent businessman, and as his daughter, you'd do well to learn from him.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: You need to be more mature, more rational. Less emotional.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Secretary, escort her out. From now on, never let her in again, no matter what.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ...Decades ago, you sat back and watched your friends get taken captive. Decades later, you're doing the same thing as people are being driven from their homes.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: If that's what you call a mature, rational, and level-headed choice...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Then I'd rather stay naive my entire life. I'd rather remain a mediocre fool.

steps.name: Secretary
steps.text: Please leave, Miss Brynley.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Don't touch me... I can leave on my own.

steps.name: Bank President
steps.text: I see you've taken care of your business?

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: However, I did hear some bad news. Some very, very unfortunate news.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Your subordinates gave my people an order to open fire at the entrance of the bank.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Without asking, without permission.

steps.name: Bank President
steps.text: And why is that a problem?

steps.name: Bank President
steps.text: We have authorization from the government, and you provided us that team. When an urgent situation arises that requires force, I don't see why it's necessary to report our every move to you, line by line.

steps.name: Bank President
steps.text: You can rest assured that our people will show restraint. But during emergencies, our own needs must come first.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: I don't think you understand what I'm saying.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: This is very bad news, but not for me. For you.

steps.name: Bank President
steps.text: S-Surely you jest...

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Nobody can go over my head and command my troops. If you really want us to coexist in harmony going forward, you'd best remember those words.

spans.text: can go over my head and command
troops. If you really want us to coexist in harmony going forward, you'd best remember those words.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: Have you finished sorting that batch of documents?

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: I'm going through them right now... I- I'll have them ready shortly.

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: Um... I just saw a repossession document. Leone Theremin just recently sold his shares...

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: But this blank contract prepared for him showed up in a pile of documents dating back more than a decade.

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: And it's not just this one document. Many of them have been misplaced... and don't have any signatures on them.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: They weren't misplaced. They were prepared in advance.

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: But, ten years ago... Many of these people hadn't even set foot in the bank yet.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: Sylvia, we have a professional actuarial system. Our concern has never been collecting a bit of interest on the loans.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: We've always had our eyes on the prize, and that's never changed: everything here.

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: Th-That isn't what you told me before...

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: True. You aren't part of the inner circle, so it's understandable that you'd be out of the loop. All the more reason to work harder and rise through the ranks.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: But given the current situation... I think you'd best make full use of the opportunity you have before you.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Woody, where did you go?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: What happened to your arm?

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Pushed my luck a little... and they finally put me in my place.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Helena, if... if I were to leave this town, would you come with me?

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: ...What'd that guy say to you?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Nothing... Just proved once and for all that he's still a good-for-nothing bastard.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: But that good-for-nothing bastard is the reason you left Laterano without a second thought, first set foot on Columbian soil, and joined a war that took nearly everything from you.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: The ideals he painted back then were so mesmerizing, so tempting... To be a hero, to lead our people to end the war, to build a new paradise, beyond Laterano.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: You know how it is for young'uns with their heads in the clouds. Always following whoever shows the most confidence when peddling their dreams.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: I know, Woody, I know... But I ain't even saying you were tricked.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: I'm just saying you don't have to be ashamed of your past. It don't matter where your journey started, because it brought you here.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Those mistakes made you who you are.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Sure, you can look back every now and then, but don't you ever regret it.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Helena...

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Care for a dance, Woody? I can teach you.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: When I was eighteen, some awkward fella taught me these steps. He was a complete fool, through-and-through, but that didn't stop me from loving the dance.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Actually, I already know how to dance...

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Oh? How come I never knew that? Since when?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: ...Since I was little. And of course you didn't know. I never told you.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Where'd you learn?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: ...On my way back to the dorms.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Wanna give it a go, then?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: ...It'd be my pleasure, ma'am.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Why didn't you just walk away when you got the order to vacate them?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: When you're disobeying orders, might as well go all the way.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Tch... What a drama queen. Even the squads that showed up later could tell you were staying behind to make sure it didn't get out of hand.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: So how's your forehead doing? Didn't expect our own people to wear kiddie gloves with the crowd but show no mercy to their coworkers.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I'm fine, just a scratch.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: And at the end of the day, we were the first to disobey orders... I didn't know what to do at that point either, so I just went back to the basics. Made sure that nobody got hurt.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Well, you did a damn good job, Teacher's Pet.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: By the way, there's something I've been meaning to tell you all day, but never got the chance...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Happy New Year.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Let me check... Sorry, but it's already past midnight.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Eh, so what?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I suppose it's not important. Maybe it just sucks that... I wasn't the one to say it first.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Happy New Year.
The heavy iron door shuts tightly, and the mechanism springs into place with the sound of a dull collision, sealing off the smell of ink coming from within.
An intoxicating smell.
With just one whiff, people will start having wondrous delusions. All their desires can be at their fingertips, and all their regrets can be made right.

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: What... do you really want?

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: And what... do you regret?

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: ...Sylvia.

steps.name: Gentle Voice
steps.text: Top of your class again? ...Golly, how did someone like me give birth to a kid as smart as you? I couldn't be more proud of you, Sylvie.

steps.name: Gentle Voice
steps.text: Are you serious, Sylvie? That's the best financial institution in all of Columbia... Goodness gracious, I can't believe my daughter actually made it! I'm so, so proud of you, I really can't say it enough!

steps.name: Gentle Voice
steps.text: Sylvie, are you sure you want to work in a bank back home? You know... I don't want my position to get in the way of what you want, especially with a decision as important as this one.

spans.text: Sylvie, are you sure you want to work in a bank back home? You know... I don't want my position to get in the way of what
want, especially with a decision as important as this one.

steps.name: Gentle Voice
steps.text: ...I'm so proud of you, my daughter.

steps.name: Gentle Voice
steps.text: *cough* *cough*... *cough* *cough*... Go, Sylvie. You can always find another job... I... I'll be fine...

steps.name: Gentle Voice
steps.text: No matter... No matter what you do... Your mom... will always be proud of you.

steps.name: Gentle Voice
steps.text: Even... when I'm no longer here...

steps.name: Gentle Voice
steps.text: You're my pride and joy... forever and always...

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: Mom...

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: I.... I hope... you'll always be proud of me.
It is a magical smell that can even twist the threads of time.
Within it, a tiny infant picks up a kite that will not take flight for decades, and a sickly old man sees the honeyed candy he longed for when he was three.
Nobody can resist its temptation.
